title: Abracadabra Money (MIM) — Cauldron Phantom Collateral / Accounting Discrepancy Analysis
root_cause: `sendValueInCollateral()` does not update internal accounting variables (`inputAmount`, `minOut`) after actually withdrawing tokens, enabling repeated borrowing against phantom collateral
steps: 2. **Action 30 (ACTION_CALL)**: Custom contract call to calculate liquidation amount

5. **Action 5 (ACTION_BORROW)**: **Additional MIM borrow** backed by phantom collateral
6. **Action 30 (ACTION_CALL)**: Swap borrowed MIM to extract ETH
